title: Create useBackupRestore hook
description: React hook that orchestrates backup file creation (serialize → write → share) and restore (pick file → validate → confirm → execute). Exposes loading state and progress messages to the UI.
steps: Import backupService, useSession, expo-file-system (FileSystem), expo-document-picker (DocumentPicker), Share from react-native
Define hook state: { loading: boolean, progress: string | null, error: string | null }

Implement createBackup(): Promise<void> — guard: return early if !congregation or type !== 'admin'; call backupService.fetchBackupData(congregation.id); serialize to JSON string; write to FileSystem.cacheDirectory + 'backup_<congregation.id>_<timestamp>.json' using FileSystem.writeAsStringAsync; call Share.share({ url: filePath, title: 'Backup', message: 'Backup da congregação' }); handle errors by setting error state

Implement validateBackupFile(data: unknown): data is BackupData — check it is an object with string congregation_id, string version, array cities (each {id, name}), array maps (each {id, city_id, name, address})

Implement restoreBackup(): Promise<void> — call DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({ type: 'application/json' }); return if cancelled; read file with FileSystem.readAsStringAsync; JSON.parse; call validateBackupFile; if congregation_id !== congregation.id throw validation error; guard type === 'admin'; set progress messages while calling backupService.deleteAllMaps, deleteAllCities, restoreCities, restoreMaps; clear progress on completion
Return { loading, progress, error, createBackup, restoreBackup } from hook
acceptanceCriteria: createBackup writes a valid JSON file and opens the native Share sheet
restoreBackup aborts and sets error if file congregation_id does not match session congregation
restoreBackup aborts if user is not admin
restoreBackup aborts if picked file fails validateBackupFile
progress string updates during restore (delete phase, cities phase, maps phase)
loading is true during async operations and false otherwise
